主要内容: On February 3, 2016, Geospace Technologies Corporation issued a press release regarding its operating results for the first fiscal quarter of 2016. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The description of the press release is qualified by reference to such exhibit. The company also filed the Form 8-K with the Securities and Exchange Commission, which includes the press release as an exhibit. The filing was signed by Thomas T. McEntire, who serves as Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary of the company.
